# Device Event

_SKOS concept in the [PKM Vocabulary](../)._

Something that occurred with a device.

## Scope note

Events originated at the device/OS level (e.g. an iOS Shortcut trigger), distinct from AppEvent and ServiceEvent.

## Broader

- [Diabetes Event](../DiabetesEvent/) — generic (ISO 25964)
